prose: Orchestrator step 3, group B, 2026-11-13: 24 proofs red on Windows on a bare bash or WinError 2/193 spawn. Measured over the 2026-11-13 census rerun (census_out6): 10 of them build an argv headed by the path of a shebang script (bin/cairn, a launcher, an askpass, a berth bin script) and Windows raises OSError WinError 193 '%1 is not a valid Win32 application'. cairn/tools/base/script_argv.py bash_script_argv already answers it (the script itself on POSIX, bash <script> on Windows) and six proofs already use it; these ten do not. The other B members call systemctl (WinError 2, no systemd on Windows) and are inherently Linux, so they are not in this ticket and wait on Q#90.
